how: Targets per chapter role, checked on the storyboard. cutSeconds: mean length of one cut (a shot with scenes counts each cut). presenter: share of chapter time with the presenter on screen (plain or with overlays). plain: share of plain presenter. overlay: share of presenter with overlays (tags, side cards, poster pairs, product cards). evidence: share of time on real pictures and data (news, people, companies, places, footage, tables). awayMax: longest stretch without the presenter, in seconds (a diagram shot may run longer).
